\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 167-169 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R173-first-pass-words-from-chapters-167-169}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for art and a match.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a toll, a motorway, traffic, a fine, a driving licence
  \item an attic, a vegetable garden, a plant, a seed, a root
  \item the environment, pollution, waste, recycling, energy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A toll? (\textbf{il pedaggio}.) A motorway? (\textbf{l'autostrada}.) Traffic? (\textbf{il traffico}.) A fine? (\textbf{la multa}.) A driving licence? (\textbf{la patente}.) An attic? (\textbf{la soffitta}.) A vegetable garden? (\textbf{l'orto}.) A plant? (\textbf{la pianta}.) A seed? (\textbf{il seme}.) A root? (\textbf{la radice}.) The environment? (\textbf{l'ambiente}.) Pollution? (\textbf{l'inquinamento}.) Waste? (\textbf{il rifiuto}.) Recycling? (\textbf{il riciclaggio}.) Energy? (\textbf{l'energia}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 170-173 — a second pass}

  \item a guitar, a piano, a violin, a drum, a ball
  \item arrival, departure, a destination, a landscape, a view
  \item a firm, a company, a colleague, a salary, a meeting
  \item geography, mathematics, science, art, a match
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A guitar? (\textbf{la chitarra}.) A piano? (\textbf{il pianoforte}.) A violin? (\textbf{il violino}.) A drum? (\textbf{il tamburo}.) A ball? (\textbf{il pallone}.) Arrival? (\textbf{l'arrivo}.) Departure? (\textbf{la partenza}.) A destination? (\textbf{la destinazione}.) A landscape? (\textbf{il paesaggio}.) A view? (\textbf{la vista}.) A firm? (\textbf{la ditta}.) A company? (\textbf{l'azienda}.) A colleague? (\textbf{il collega}.) A salary? (\textbf{lo stipendio}.) A meeting? (\textbf{la riunione}.) Geography? (\textbf{la geografia}.) Mathematics? (\textbf{la matematica}.) Science? (\textbf{la scienza}.) Art? (\textbf{l'arte}.) A match? (\textbf{la partita}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
